comments.body_html: After overthinking “smeared”, I’d like to tell you that I don’t make mods for the spt community. I make mods for myself and people who suggest them. The ports I’ve released are mods that I enjoyed and wanted to move forward to the current spt, the retextures are all random ideas and fun mini-projects I can work on while I progress through life, and the full auto mods are either suggested by the community or ways I could enjoy the game further. I don’t mind if my release history is all over, it’s true to me. Thank you.
